note: Issue #684: the moment you go down on foot (src/systems/camera/defeated_shot.gd, started by Garrison._on_player_downed). Seconds are real time from the killing hit. 'flash_s' / 'flash_alpha': the white flash frame, over a close shot of you 'flash_side' m to the side and 'flash_up' m up through a 'flash_fov' degree lens (your body shows in third person for the whole shot). 'slow_s' / 'slow_scale': the fall starts in slow motion (Engine.time_scale; never on LAN). 'cut_at': the cut from the flash shot to the shot from above: 'height' m over the body and 'back' m behind it (the way your camera was), rising 'rise' m/s and turning 'orbit_deg_s' round it, through a 'fov' degree lens. 'text' comes in at 'title_at' over 'title_fade' s, 'title_size' px, its middle 'title_y' of the way down the screen (under the body, which the shot keeps in the middle). The screen goes black from 'black_from' to 'total', when you wake in the port's pit (Garrison._wake_in_pit); it clears over 'clear_s'. 'ship': your ship destroyed with you aboard (shot down, a crash, a lost orbital fight; ShipPilot._defeat_aboard): the same shot round the point she blew up at, these numbers over the ones above; the distances and 'rise' are for a 9 m ship and grow with her length (DefeatedShot.wreck_cfg). You wake in the pit as on foot, the ship towed to her pad.
